abstract: Abstract Do policies mitigating fire sale externalities improve financial stability? We study this question in a model of financial intermediation where banks are subject to self‐fulfilling bank runs and may sell long‐term assets subject to cash‐in‐the‐market pricing. Without regulations, banks hold more long‐term assets than socially optimal, causing inefficiently large fire sales in crises. Policymakers may regulate to mitigate this externality, but lack commitment. The optimal policy depends on how regulation affects the probability of self‐fulfilling runs, and we offer a robust control theory of this relationship. Ignoring this effect could inadvertently increase fragility and lower welfare. Internalizing it robustly increases welfare.
abstract_zh: 缓解抛售外部性的政策能否提升金融稳定性？我们在一个银行面临自我实现的挤兑风险且可能以市场现金定价出售长期资产的金融中介模型中研究这一问题。在无监管状态下，银行持有的长期资产规模超过社会最优水平，导致危机期间出现低效的大规模抛售。政策制定者可通过监管缓解这一外部性，但缺乏承诺能力。最优政策取决于监管如何影响自我实现挤兑的概率，我们为此关系提供了稳健的控制理论。忽视这一效应可能无意中加剧脆弱性并降低福利，而将其内生化则能稳健地提升福利。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Financial Stability with Fire Sale Externalities
title_zh: 具有甩卖外部性的金融稳定性

abstract: This article examines the effect of firms’ lobbying expenditures on penalties received from public competition authorities. We show that lobbying expenditures are negatively associated with the amount of the cartel sanction, across and within cartel. Our estimates also report that cartel sanctions are more responsive to lobbying expenditures when the lobbying firm qualifies for the leniency programme. If we consider lobbying expenditures as a proxy for informativeness, more uncertainty in uncovering the cartel incentivizes the antitrust authority to reduce the cartel sanction in exchange for lobby.
title: Lobbying and cartel enforcement

abstract: Inflation convergence with the US is a goal for Latin American nations. Although studies on inflation within countries distinguish between trend and cyclical inflation, papers on co-movement between Latin America and the US have ignored this distinction. We gather quarterly data on inflation for eleven Latin American countries and the US over 1987–2023 to investigate this issue. We employ the Christiano-Fitzgerald filter to decompose inflation into trend and cyclical components, and use metrics of co-movement that go beyond correlation. We find trend inflation is more cohesive than cyclical between the US and Latin America. Co-movement in trend inflation rates have increased more in recent decades than those of cyclical rates. There has been an increase in cohesion between Latin American and US inflation since covid. However, while other works have examined the cohesion between US and Latin (headline) inflation, we are the first to our knowledge to perform a comparison with co-movement of inflation within US regions. This comparison reveals much less association between inflation across nations than there is between the different regions in the US. This is a troubling result for countries that are dollarized, such as Ecuador, which displays a low level of co-movement with US inflation.
abstract_zh: 与美国的通胀趋同是拉丁美洲国家的一个目标。尽管关于国家内部通胀的研究区分了趋势性通胀和周期性通胀，但探讨拉丁美洲与美国之间通胀联动性的论文却忽略了这一区分。我们收集了1987年至2023年间11个拉丁美洲国家和美国的季度通胀数据来研究这一问题。采用克里斯蒂亚诺-菲茨杰拉德滤波器将通胀分解为趋势成分和周期成分，并使用超越相关性的联动性指标。研究发现，美国与拉丁美洲之间的趋势性通胀比周期性通胀更具一致性。近几十年来，趋势性通胀率的联动性增长幅度大于周期性通胀率。自新冠疫情以来，拉丁美洲与美国通胀之间的协同性有所增强。然而，尽管已有研究考察了美国与拉丁美洲（整体）通胀的协同性，但据我们所知，我们是首个将其与美国各地区内部通胀联动性进行比较的研究。这一比较揭示出，国家间的通胀关联性远低于美国各地区之间的关联性。对于实行美元化的国家（如厄瓜多尔）而言，这一结果令人担忧——该国与美国通胀的联动性水平较低。
title: Inflation Co-movement between Latin America and the US: trends versus cycles and developments since covid
title_zh: 拉丁美洲与美国通胀联动：趋势与周期及新冠疫情以来的发展

abstract: FinTech harnesses emerging technologies to drive corporate innovation, playing a crucial role in promoting green technological advancement and serving as a key pathway towards global sustainable development. This study employs a multi-sector technological progress model to examine firms’ R&D activities and interactions with financial institutions, investigating the impact and mechanisms of FinTech on green technological innovation. An empirical analysis is conducted using the Double Machine Learning (DML) approach, which addresses the curse of dimensionality and mitigates multicollinearity in high-dimensional data. The findings reveal that FinTech significantly enhances manufacturing enterprises’ preference for green technological innovation, a conclusion that remains robust across various sensitivity tests. Additionally, FinTech fosters green innovation by alleviating financing constraints, increasing internal R&D investment, and expanding the number of R&D personnel. Furthermore, corporate environmental information disclosure and alignment with government policies positively moderate this process, amplifying FinTech’s role in driving green technological progress. These findings provide scientific empirical evidence and policy insights to optimize the effectiveness of FinTech in promoting green innovation in manufacturing enterprises, contributing to the realization of national sustainable development goals.
abstract_zh: 金融科技利用新兴技术驱动企业创新，在推动绿色技术进步中发挥关键作用，是实现全球可持续发展的重要路径。本研究采用多部门技术进步模型，考察企业的研发活动及其与金融机构的互动，探究金融科技对绿色技术创新的影响及作用机制。通过双机器学习方法进行实证分析，该方法能够应对高维数据中的维度灾难问题并缓解多重共线性。研究结果表明，金融科技显著提升了制造业企业对绿色技术创新的偏好，这一结论在多种敏感性检验中依然稳健。此外，金融科技通过缓解融资约束、增加内部研发投入以及扩大研发人员规模来促进绿色创新。进一步地，企业环境信息披露水平以及与政府政策的契合度正向调节这一过程，增强了金融科技推动绿色技术进步的作用。这些发现为优化金融科技促进制造业企业绿色创新的有效性提供了科学实证依据和政策启示，有助于实现国家可持续发展目标。

title: From digital finance to green growth: the role of FinTech in sustainable manufacturing
title_zh: 从数字金融到绿色增长：金融科技在可持续制造业中的作用

abstract: The topic of measures to fight against poverty is one of the most debated by decision-makers, commentators, and insiders in Italy. After a short life, despite the increase in poverty and inequalities in Italy, the universal income support measures were abolished in 2023. This paper presents a counterfactual impact evaluation of the Inclusion Income (II), Italy’s first income support measure, on severe material deprivation from 2017 to 2021. We rely on a novel database collected from a survey addressed to beneficiary and non-beneficiary but eligible families of universal income support measures in Italy. Our results show a positive impact of the monetary benefit on the probability of not being severely materially deprived in 2019 but not in 2021. The in-kind part of the benefits, namely the socio-economic reinsertion personalized project, is, instead, effective after 2019, confirming its importance in addressing structural disadvantages and providing a long-term solution to material deprivation for the most disadvantaged groups. Results also show that the in-kind benefit is more effective in the South. Policy implications concerning the potential effectiveness of the polices replacing the II are discussed.
abstract_zh: 意大利决策者、评论人士及业内人士对反贫困措施议题的争论最为激烈。尽管贫困与不平等现象持续加剧，意大利的全民收入支持措施在实施短短数年后，于2023年被废止。本文基于反事实影响评估方法，考察了意大利首个收入支持措施——包容性收入（II）在2017至2021年间对严重物质匮乏的影响。我们利用一项针对意大利全民收入支持措施受益家庭与符合条件但未受益家庭的新型调查数据库展开研究。结果表明：2019年货币福利对降低严重物质匮乏概率具有正向效应，但该效应在2021年未显现。而福利中的实物部分——即社会经济再融入个性化项目——在2019年后持续发挥效力，证实其在解决结构性劣势方面的重要性，并为最弱势群体摆脱物质匮乏提供了长期解决方案。研究还发现，实物福利在意大利南部地区效果更显著。本文讨论了替代II政策的潜在有效性及其政策启示。
title: The impact of income support measures on material deprivation: the case of Italy
title_zh: 收入支持措施对物质匮乏的影响：以意大利为例

abstract: Traditional passive fund performance evaluation relies on tracking error metrics, which have a short-term orientation. As such, these metrics may not appropriately quantify the long-term performance of passive funds, which is of particular interest to buy-and-hold investors. This study considers the potential shortcomings of current passive investment evaluation practices by comparing the performance of a sample of United States equity exchange traded funds (ETFs) based on short-run (tracking error) and long-run (cointegration-based) tracking metrics over the period 1 January 2013 to 25 September 2024. The cointegration approach employed accommodates structural breaks. Our findings reveal significant disparities in rankings, highlighting the importance of aligning performance evaluation with investment horizons. We also introduce a novel metric, ‘Overall Tracking Performance’, which integrates both short- and long-run measures. Finally, we demonstrate that top-performing funds maintain consistent tracking performance over successive periods, irrespective of the measure of tracking performance. These results offer meaningful insights for both investors and fund managers seeking a more comprehensive approach to passive fund performance evaluation.
abstract_zh: 传统被动型基金绩效评估依赖跟踪误差指标，这类指标具有短期导向性。对于长期持有型投资者尤为关注的被动型基金长期绩效，这些指标可能无法进行恰当量化。本研究通过对比2013年1月1日至2024年9月25日期间美国股票交易所交易基金（ETF）样本基于短期（跟踪误差）与长期（协整）跟踪指标的绩效表现，探讨当前被动投资评估实践存在的潜在缺陷。所采用的协整方法能够适应结构性突变。研究结果揭示排名存在显著差异，凸显了绩效评估与投资期限相匹配的重要性。我们同时引入"综合跟踪绩效"这一新型指标，该指标整合了短期与长期度量维度。最后证明，无论采用何种跟踪绩效度量方式，表现最优的基金均能在连续期间保持稳定的跟踪绩效。这些发现为寻求更全面被动型基金绩效评估方法的投资者与基金管理人提供了重要启示。
title: Evaluating passive fund performance: short-term versus long-term metrics
title_zh: 被动基金绩效评估：短期与长期指标的比较

abstract: The removal of institutional restrictions on innovation can foster industrial growth, but the success of deregulation remains uncertain due to differences in firms’ motivation and capabilities to exploit the opportunities it creates. In the context of the 2008 deregulation of incrementally modified drugs (IMDs) in Korea, we argue that firms’ motivation to develop IMDs depends on their performance relative to aspiration levels, and that their capabilities – specifically, the specialization and scope of knowledge assets – jointly facilitate the launch of IMDs. An empirical analysis of Korean pharmaceutical firms from 2008 to 2017 revealed that firms were more likely to introduce IMDs when their performance was near aspiration levels or when they possessed both diverse and specialized knowledge assets. This study enhances our understanding of the internal factors shaping variations in firms’ responses to innovation deregulation and offers insights for policymakers seeking to promote innovation.
abstract_zh: 取消对创新的制度性限制可以促进产业增长，但由于企业利用由此创造机会的动机和能力存在差异，放松管制的成效仍不确定。以2008年韩国渐进改良药物（IMDs）放松管制为背景，我们认为企业开发IMDs的动机取决于其绩效与期望水平的差距，而其能力——特别是知识资产的专精程度与范围——共同推动了IMDs的上市。对2008年至2017年韩国制药企业的实证分析表明，当企业绩效接近期望水平，或同时拥有多样化与专精化知识资产时，其推出IMDs的可能性更高。本研究深化了对企业应对创新放松管制差异的内在因素的理解，并为旨在促进创新的政策制定者提供了启示。
title: Antecedents of firm responses to innovation deregulation: evidence from the incrementally modified drug policy in Korea
title_zh: 企业应对创新放松管制的先决条件：来自韩国渐进式药品政策改革的证据

abstract: Research on managerial delegation typically suggests that firms in a Cournot duopoly compete more aggressively in the product market post-delegation, causing their profits to decline. This paper investigates the profitability of delegation by incorporating a sales-delegation strategy into a spatial barbell model, where consumers are asymmetrically distributed at the two endpoints of a line segment. We find that the firm located closer to the more populated market may benefit from delegation. Notably, this occurs when the locational equilibrium shifts from agglomeration to separation following delegation. Although the firms compete more intensely under delegation, social welfare decreases when the locational equilibrium changes from separation to agglomeration and the transport rate is sufficiently high.
abstract_zh: 关于管理授权的研究通常表明，在古诺双寡头市场中，企业授权后会在产品市场上展开更激烈的竞争，导致其利润下降。本文通过将销售授权策略引入空间杠铃模型（其中消费者非对称地分布于线段两端）来研究授权的盈利性。研究发现，位于人口更密集市场附近的企业可能从授权中获益。值得注意的是，当授权导致区位均衡从集聚转向分离时，这一现象才会出现。尽管授权下企业竞争更为激烈，但当区位均衡从分离转向集聚且运输费率足够高时，社会福利反而会下降。
title: The profitability of managerial delegation with endogenous locations
title_zh: 内生选址下管理层授权的盈利能力

abstract: This paper estimates the impact of countercyclical reserve requirements (RRs) on credit. We explore differential bank exposure to RRs in matched loan‐level data from Brazil, where RRs have been used extensively to pursue financial stability. We find that, after tightening RRs, more exposed banks reduce credit to firms; after loosening, they expand credit supply. During booms, private domestic banks with lower capital are more responsive to a tightening of RRs and to a simultaneous tightening of the short‐term policy rate. We also find that higher levels of economic policy uncertainty weaken this channel, and real effects in employment are modest.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了逆周期存款准备金率（RRs）对信贷的影响。我们利用巴西的匹配贷款级数据，探讨了银行对RRs的不同敞口，该国广泛运用RRs以追求金融稳定。研究发现，在收紧RRs后，敞口较大的银行减少了对企业的信贷；而在放松后，则扩大了信贷供给。在经济繁荣时期，资本充足率较低的私人国内银行对RRs收紧及短期政策利率同步上调的反应更为敏感。我们还发现，经济政策不确定性的上升会削弱这一传导渠道，且对就业的实际影响较为温和。
authors: RODRIGO BARBONE GONZALEZ, JOÃO BARATA RIBEIRO BLANCO BARROSO
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Macroprudential, Monetary Policy Synergies and Credit Supply: Evidence from Matched Bank‐Firm Loan‐Level Data in Brazil
title_zh: 宏观审慎与货币政策的协同效应及信贷供给：基于巴西银行-企业贷款匹配数据的实证研究
